Beat intero rigenerato in inquadratura unica continua (scelta di Francesco: 13 s, 117 crediti, nessun margine per un secondo tentativo). Mondo e cast dalla still già approvata B1_SOBER_STILL usata come start image. Stesso workflow validato: seedance_2_0, 9:16 1080p std, generate_audio false. 1 tentativo, 0 retry.

prompt_blocks.V916: Preserve faces, hair, hands and anatomy exactly, no morphing, no people or objects appearing or disappearing, no text, letters or numbers appearing, nobody looks at the camera, single continuous shot, vertical 9:16.

jobs.prompt: An ordinary working moment in the same bright contemporary Italian pharmacy; camera almost still with a very slight natural drift. Throughout the whole shot the female pharmacist and the customer stay busy with each other: the pharmacist keeps serving, handing over and explaining the small white box, the customer on the public side keeps listening and answering naturally. Neither of them ever turns toward the door. FIRST SECONDS: the owner is behind the counter working at the till, attending to the ongoing sale; the man in the dark suit with the briefcase stands just inside the entrance on the far left. THEN, unhurried and polite, the man in the suit starts walking forward along the public side and approaches the counter, stopping a couple of steps from it, near but slightly behind the customer, waiting to be noticed; he is courteous and ordinary, never pushy, never threatening, he does not interrupt, he does not speak over anyone. AS HE ARRIVES the owner notices him: he lifts his eyes from the sale with a tired, mildly bored and unimpressed expression, holds that look at the visitor for a moment, then makes one small, restrained polite gesture that clearly means not now — a brief lift of the palm or a small shake of the head — and a short glance down toward the customer he is serving, to show he is busy; then he immediately returns his attention to his work and to the sale. The visitor accepts it and simply waits where he is. Nobody else reacts: no head turns toward the door, no group reaction, no surprise, no drama, no argument. Everyday realistic pace, unhurried micro-movements, 13 seconds.
must_show: farmacia che continua a lavorare per tutta la durata
collaboratrice e cliente sempre impegnate nella vendita, mai voltate verso la porta
visitatore che si AVVICINA al banco camminando, con calma e garbo, e poi si ferma ad attendere
titolare che alza lo sguardo con aria tediata e lo tiene un istante sul visitatore
gesto minimo e cortese del titolare che significa «non adesso», con occhiata al cliente che sta servendo
titolare che torna subito al lavoro
must_not_show: visitatore che resta immobile sulla soglia per tutto il clip
teste che si girano verso la porta o reazione corale
cliente bloccata, sorpresa o che si volta
visitatore minaccioso, invadente o che parla sopra gli altri
discussione, gesto brusco o scortesia del titolare
